content.text:
No blocking findings.

- GraphQL transport and `--paginate --slurp` shape are correct: `$endCursor`, `after`, and `pageInfo` support all pages.
- Retry recovery still scans every reservation and rejects duplicate run IDs or conflicting source/image/digest.
- Commit target and exact tag-name checks remain equivalent to REST.
- Lightweight tags, non-JSON annotations, and unrelated JSON annotations are skipped.

The new test covers flattening multiple pages; actual pagination mechanics rely on `gh`. Reported live preparation and 10 passing tests support the change.
